caption: The drawing features a black and white depiction of a vine with leaves situated in the upper left corner and along the top edge of the composition. The vine has several twisting and overlapping branches that extend horizontally across the top and vertically down the left side, creating a border-like effect in these areas. The leaves are clustered at various points along the branches, and are illustrated with distinct, pointed shapes. The lines of the vine and branches are flowing and organic, with shading that gives them a three-dimensional appearance. The remaining space in the drawing, occupying the majority of the lower and right portion, is left blank. There is a signature in small text that reads "CHASE, NORA" in the lower right quadrant of the image, along with the number "33." The background is a plain, light-colored surface.
title: Grille on Porch
